verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile ships Copilot code review that analyzes PRs and suggests improvements, plus Copilot chat that provides insights into public/private repos and can open PRs, matching the AI-insights story. However, this is all vendor-documented; there is no independent/hands-on community evidence confirming quality or reliability of these AI suggestions on mobile specifically. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of AI insight quality, and broader 'insights from my data' beyond code review/chat (e.g., proactive analytics or dashboards).
